name: Dikla
title: Descendant of Joktan
summary: Dikla was one of the thirteen sons of Joktan, who was a descendant of Shem, Noah's son. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as part of the origins of the nations after the flood. The name Dikla is traditionally associated with palm trees and may be connected to an Arab tribe or region.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Table of Nations
keyEvents.description: Dikla is listed as one of Joktan's sons in the Table of Nations, which describes how the peoples of the earth spread after the flood.

keyEvents.title: Joktan's Sons Listed
keyEvents.description: All thirteen of Joktan's sons, including Dikla, are mentioned as ancestors of peoples in the Arabian Peninsula and surrounding regions.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the Genealogy of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Dikla is mentioned again in the genealogical record of 1 Chronicles, confirming his place in Shem's lineage through Eber and Joktan.

keyEvents.title: Shem's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Dikla is part of the lineage of Shem, representing one of the major branches of humanity after Noah and the flood.
